responsibility: Declares the small public RTL loop-unrolling interface shared with neighboring loop passes. In this module it exposes the main unroll_loops entry point and the split_edge_and_insert helper used when transformations need to insert RTL instruction sequences on CFG edges. It is a companion header for the RTL unrolling and related loop-transformation code rather than containing analysis or optimization logic itself.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the minimal public declarations for RTL loop unrolling, namely the unroll_loops entry point and split_edge_and_insert helper shared with nearby passes. Unlike gcc/loop-unroll.cc, it does not contain the unrolling algorithms, heuristics, or body-rewriting logic.
